name: ^queuePlace\.getStore$
reason: AsyncLocalStorage holds the place withQueuePlace set; the twin reads only its held flag and the enqueue arguments it decides are checked.

name: ^recovery\.unref$
reason: Node timer call with no decision; its answer is never read.

name: ^inputs\.(openWork|publish|recordUsage|release|rootAttributes|sandboxCpu\.(typeAttributes|usage)|spans\.closeOrphans|stepTiming\.clear|taskTotals\.(cacheWriteTokens|steps|usage))$
reason: Callbacks the run loop passes to settleRun; their answers are inputs, and every argument settleRun computes for them is checked.

name: ^process\.memoryUsage$
reason: Runtime reading of resident size; only the rss rounding is computed from it.

name: ^root\.span\.(end|recordException|setAttributes|setStatus)$
reason: OpenTelemetry span methods with no answer the twin reads; their arguments are checked.
